story.originalTitle: What’s behind Cadillac’s shock F1 team principal change – and why it happened now
story.summaryEn: Just over a week before the Dutch Grand Prix, Cadillac abruptly announced that Graeme Lowdon had been replaced as team principal with immediate effect by Marcin Budkowski, a move that stunned the paddock.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克震惊F1车队的领队变动背后是什么——以及为什么选在这个时候发生
凯迪拉克F1首席执行官丹·托里斯表示，车队在“新阶段”需要不同类型的领导方式，但他承认这次变动比预期来得更早。那么，这支美国F1车队为什么认为必须现在就采取行动？
在荷兰大奖赛于赞德沃特开赛前一个多星期，F1世界突然从夏休期中被惊醒。
英国时间下午3点，凯迪拉克认定时机已到，宣布了一项震惊车坛的消息：格拉姆·洛登立即卸任领队一职，由马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接替。
这条消息中有两个要素本身并不特别奇怪。对于围场里的许多人来说，一段时间以来已经很清楚：虽然广受爱爱的洛登在车队最初的组建阶段发挥了关键作用，但他不会在更长期内继续担任车队领队。
凯迪拉克转向布德科夫斯基这样的人物也并不特别令人惊讶。这位接受法国教育的波兰人在一级方程式的多个不同领域都积累了经验：在普罗斯特、法拉利和迈凯伦等车队担任技术职务，通过在国际汽车联合会（FIA）的任职接触了规则制定方面的工作，随后又在阿尔派的经历中积累了领导层面的经验。
凯迪拉克承认这一任命比计划来得更早
主要问题在于时机：为什么是现在，为什么这么快？
凯迪拉克在新闻稿以及随后的媒体发布会上都强调，这是一次“计划中的过渡”，但即便如此，时机也极不寻常。它发生在夏休期期间，而且才进行到凯迪拉克第一个F1赛季的中途——换句话说，极其早。
“正如你们所知，每当我们在F1中进行过渡时，都是非常困难的，”托里斯说，这实际上等于承认，进行这种干预并没有完美的时机。
话虽如此，这位54岁的美国人确实承认，原本并不打算这么早做出改变。是的，替换洛登本来就在计划之中，但不一定是在这个时候。
“格雷姆和我一直谈论过，在某个时候会有一场过渡，”他继续说道。“这个决定是我做出的。而且我认为机会窗口非常狭窄。”
“看看我们正在打造的东西，这里有机会去创造一些全新的、具有创新性的事物。我不想做的是去打造一个已经被别人做过、已经很陈旧的东西，然后再试图去改进它。所以我认为，这次变革的时机来得比人们预想的要早。”
凯迪拉克承认，这并非一个双方共同作出的决定，洛登也只是在公告发布的当天早上才被告知此事。
这自然引出了一个问题：凯迪拉克最初计划在什么时候更换洛登。
然而，当Motorsport.com问到最初的设想是否是在车队首个赛季结束时才作出这一变动时，托里斯拒绝透露细节：“我不想给出一个时间表。我认为这本来会是一种走一步看一步的事情。”
实际上，这个过程的某些部分是在最后一刻才敲定的。布德科夫斯基在媒体会议上透露，他甚至还没有时间好好参观一下工厂，而托里斯则解释说，洛登是在公开发布消息的当天早上才被告知的。
“所以格雷厄姆和我今天早上谈过了，所以我认为从那个角度来说，这是一次非常近期的谈话，”托里斯说，并补充说这并不是一个双方共同的决定。
据凯迪拉克称，目前的成绩并没有起到作用。相反，一个考量是，新任领队在这个阶段仍然可以积极影响2027年的项目，而如果更晚更换领导层，那几乎是不可能实现的。
人工智能（AI）、沟通与通用汽车（GM）：为什么需要改变
比时机更有意思的是，为什么凯迪拉克认为在车队的下一个阶段需要一种不同类型的领导层，以及为什么它选择了布德科夫斯基。
尽管对于一支新军来说，赛道上的竞争局面相当令人鼓舞——甚至可能好于预期——但幕后还有一些需要改进的地方。其中包括工厂内的沟通：防止车队内部出现各自为政的孤岛，确保不同部门尽可能高效地协同工作。
托里斯认为，在这个新阶段，这支美国车队需要一种不同类型的领导方式。
托里斯承认这些问题，并将它们确定为车队新领导方向的关键重点。
“我认为，其中很多问题确实不同程度地存在，但它们都属于初创期的磨合问题，”凯迪拉克的F1首席执行官这样认为。
“我认为在新组建的组织中，沟通永远是需要重点改进的方面，要确保各项工作组织得当、协调一致，并在建设阶段保持士气。所以这些问题是可以预料的，而且它们确实不同程度地存在。”
除了人为因素之外，托里斯认为通用汽车内部仍有大量尚未开发的潜力。例如，这适用于人工智能以及通用汽车在该领域拥有的工具。托里斯还认为，布德科夫斯基能够比凯迪拉克迄今为止更好地利用这些资源。
当Motorsport.com问到他在下一阶段关注什么时，托里斯明确表示：“展望未来，我认为我们寻求的是一位能力非常强的技术领队的模式。如果你看看马尔钦的背景，看看他在一级方程式取得的成就，他无疑完全符合要求。”
"另外，我认为马尔钦离开一级方程式这段时间，让他能够以一种全新的视角去审视一级方程式的演变与发展，审视通用汽车和TWG集团的整体资源，并真正思考一支未来的一级方程式车队应该是什么样子。"
而这最后一点正是人工智能发挥作用的地方："人工智能以及类似这些技术的作用，我认为我们在一级方程式中通过凯迪拉克所能运用的通用汽车工具集，目前仅仅触及了皮毛。所以我认为在这方面还有更多工作要做。"
人工智能也是布德科夫斯基首次以凯迪拉克车队领队身份面对媒体时强调的重点之一。在他看来，未来的一级方程式车队将与如今的车队大不相同。
"一级方程式正在发生很多变化，与此同时整个社会也在经历巨大的变革，人工智能正在接管许多事情，"他说。
"我认为这项技术正在进入一级方程式（F1），但我们现在还处于非常非常初期的阶段。不过我确实认为，未来的车队将会与现在的样子大不相同。"
托里斯认为，通用汽车（GM）的工具和技术至今尚未被充分发挥其潜力。
这与凯迪拉克的雄心相吻合，即把车队的重心略微向美国转移。这并不是要从银石基地拿走任何东西，而是要在美国的土地上挖掘其他技术和专业知识。
"显然，由于一级方程式（F1）的人才集中在英国，我们的大部分招聘工作都是在英国进行的，今后将进入一个更以美国为中心的阶段。这不是通过转移人员来实现的，而是通过在其他地点继续发展组织，"托里斯解释道。
"我们也在研究来自其他行业的创新能力。马尔钦提到了航空航天业，还有一些其他行业。另外，还要进一步整合通用汽车现有的工具体系。我们将着眼于所有这些方面，并在所有基地之间进行整合。"
除了沟通方面的初期问题之外，这将成为布德科夫斯基最重要的任务之一。凯迪拉克认为，尽管车队仍处于起步阶段，但一些潜力尚未被挖掘出来，而布德科夫斯基需要从长远角度挖掘的，正是通用汽车内部的这种潜力。
与此同时，目前的这一举措表明，在一级方程式中没有人能保证自己的职位安全无虞，始终需要拿出成绩——即使你是从零开始组建一支一级方程式车队，并可能认为自己还有充足的时间。
布德科夫斯基必须在短期任务——特别是解决凯迪拉克的可靠性问题——与为车队制定长期愿景之间取得平衡。
detailEn: What’s behind Cadillac’s shock F1 team principal change – and why it happened now

Cadillac F1 CEO Dan Towriss says the team needs a different type of leadership for “a new phase”, but admits the change has come earlier than expected. So why does the American F1 outfit believe it needs to act now?
More than a week before the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, the Formula 1 world was abruptly awakened from its summer break.
At 3pm UK time, Cadillac decided the time was right to make a shock announcement: Graeme Lowdon had been replaced as team principal with immediate effect by Marcin Budkowski.

Two elements of that news are not particularly strange in themselves. For many in the paddock, it had already been clear for some time that while the well-liked Lowdon had been crucial during the team's initial build-up phase, he would not remain team principal in the longer term.

Nor is it particularly surprising that Cadillac has turned to someone like Budkowski. The French-educated Pole has gained experience across several different areas of F1: technical roles at the likes of Prost, Ferrari and McLaren, the regulatory side through his stint at the FIA, and subsequently the leadership side via his time at Alpine.
Cadillac admits it came earlier than planned
The main question is the timing: why now, and why so soon?

Cadillac stressed both in its press release and during the subsequent media session that it was a “planned transition”, but even then the timing is highly unusual. It comes in the middle of the summer break and only halfway through Cadillac's very first F1 season – extremely early, in other words.
"Anytime we're making a transition in Formula 1, as you guys know, it's very difficult," Towriss said, effectively concluding that there is no perfect moment for such an intervention.
That said, the 54-year-old American does admit that the intention was not to make the change this early. Yes, replacing Lowdon was part of the plan all along, but not necessarily at this point.
"Graeme and I always talked about that there would be a transition at some point," he continued. "This decision was mine. And I think there's a very narrow window of opportunity.

"When you look at what we're building, there is an opportunity to build something new and innovative. What I didn't want to do was to build something that's already been done, something that's old and then try to improve it. So I think that the time for that change came sooner than was expected."
Cadillac admits that it was not a mutual decision and that Lowdon was only informed on the morning of the announcement
That naturally raises the question of when Cadillac had initially planned to replace Lowdon.

However, when Motorsport.com asked whether the original idea had been to make the change at the end of the team's first season, Towriss declined to go into detail: "I wouldn't put a timetable on it. I think it was going to be, you know, a wait-and-see kind of thing."

In practice, some parts of the process came together at the last minute. Budkowski revealed during the media session that he had not even had the time for a proper factory tour yet, while Towriss explained that Lowdon was only informed on the morning before the public announcement.
"So Graeme and I spoke this morning, so I think it is a very recent conversation from that perspective," Towriss said, adding that it had not been a mutual decision.

The current results did not play a role, according to Cadillac. Instead, one consideration was that a new team principal can still actively influence the 2027 project at this stage, whereas that would have been almost impossible with a later leadership change.
AI, communication and GM: why change is needed
Even more interesting than the timing is why Cadillac believes it needs a different type of leadership for the team's next phase, and why it has chosen Budkowski.

Although the competitive picture on track is fairly encouraging for a newcomer – perhaps even better than expected – there are areas behind the scenes that need improving. These include communication at the factory: preventing silos within the team and ensuring that the different departments work together as effectively as possible.
Towriss argues that, in this new phase, the American team needs a different kind of leadership
Towriss acknowledges those issues and identifies them as key focal points of the team's new leadership direction.
"A lot of those issues, which to different degrees do exist, I think are teething issues," Cadillac's F1 CEO reckoned.

"I think in new organizations, communication is always going to be a focal point to improve, making sure things are organized correctly, aligned correctly, and maintaining morale through that building phase. So those issues are to be expected, and they do exist in different degrees."

Aside from the human element, Towriss believes there is still plenty of untapped potential within General Motors. That applies, for example, to artificial intelligence and the tools GM has in that area. Towriss also believes Budkowski can make greater use of those resources than Cadillac has managed so far.

Asked by Motorsport.com what he was looking at for the next stage, Towriss clarified: "As we look to the future, I think we’re looking at a model with a very strong technical team principal. And I think if you look at Marcin's background, what he's accomplished in Formula 1, he certainly fits the bill."

"Also, I think the time that Marcin has had away from Formula 1 provides him with a perspective to look at both how F1 has evolved and developed, look at the resources across General Motors and TWG, and really look at what a future vision of a Formula 1 team can look like."

And it is precisely on that final point that AI comes into play: "The role of AI and those kinds of things, I think we've only scratched the surface of the tool set that GM has to offer in F1 through Cadillac. And so I think there's more work to be done there."
AI was also one of the points Budkowski emphasised during his first media appearance as Cadillac’s team boss. In his view, the F1 team of the future will look very different from today's squads.
"There's a lot of changes in F1 and then there's a huge societal change going on as well, with AI taking over a lot of things," he said.
"And I think it's coming to F1, but we're at the very, very beginning of that. But I do think the teams of the future will look very different from what they look now."
Towriss believes that GM’s tools have not been utilised to their full potential so far

This ties in with Cadillac’s ambition to shift the team's centre of gravity slightly more towards the United States. Not by taking anything away from the Silverstone facility, but by tapping into other technologies and expertise on American soil.

"Obviously, with the concentration of F1 talent in the UK, the bulk of our recruitment has been in the UK and is moving into a more US-centric phase going forward. That is not by moving people, but by continuing to grow the organization in other locations," Towriss explained.

"We’re also looking at innovation capabilities from other industries. Marcin mentioned aerospace and there are some other industries as well. And again, further integration of the tool set available at GM. We'll be looking at all of those things, integrating those across all the locations."

Alongside the teething issues around communication, this will be one of Budkowski's most important tasks. Cadillac believes that, despite the team still being in its infancy, potential has been left on the table, and it is precisely that potential within GM that Budkowski needs to tap into for the longer term.

At the same time, the current move shows that nobody in F1 is safe in their job and that there is always a need to deliver – even when you are building an F1 team from scratch and might think you have time on your side.
Budkowski must balance his short-term tasks – particularly resolving Cadillac's reliability issues – with setting out a long-term vision for the team

detailZh: 阿尔派的2024年F1赛车部件即将变身终极收藏品展示。F1 Authentics，F1的官方纪念品平台，将开始拍卖一个2024年赛事使用的变速箱载体，配以带有工作DRS襟翼的赛事规格后翼，安装在定制的展示架上。
从阿尔派 2024年Formula 1赛车中使用的变速箱载体被配对了一个带有工作DRS襟翼的赛事规格后翼，形成了一个不同寻常的收藏品展示。
赛车文化不仅限于赛道。它包括车手的生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
阿尔派 2024年Formula 1赛车的一部分即将进行拍卖，并且已经被改造成可以放在你客厅的东西。
F1 Authentics，F1官方纪念品平台，正在开启对一款非常酷的2024年赛事使用的变速箱载体以及与其配套的赛车规格后翼的竞拍。变速箱载体上仍保留着其原始的FIA封印，而该翼保留了可工作的DRS襟翼。
这可能会成为你在凝视窗外，一边喝着早晨的咖啡一边沉思时可以依靠的不可思议的东西。
这个组合，是‘奥斯汀拍卖’的一部分，标题为BWT 阿尔派 Formula 1 Team 2024 Race-Used Gearbox Carrier & Rear Wing Assembly。其中只有变速箱载体被描述为赛事使用，而后翼是赛车规格部件。
由碳纤维和金属制成，变速箱载体构成了汽车后结构的一部分，而其上方的翼，仍然保持着阿尔派的粉色和蓝色BWT涂装，并在翼尖上印有Castrol品牌，负责管理空气流动并在汽车后部产生下压力。
DRS襟翼仍然可以打开和关闭。当你有访客时，这将是一场令人难以置信的展示。
埃斯蒂班·奥康，阿尔派，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
虽然2024年对阿尔派来说并不是一个完美的赛季，但它确实为当时的全法阵容带来了双料领奖台。
在艰难的开局之后，车队在车手积分榜上排名第六，得益于圣保罗大奖赛上的雨战，埃斯蒂班·奥康获得第二名，皮埃尔·加斯利获得第三名。
detailEn: Alpine's 2024 F1 car has been turned into the ultimate collector's display
A race-used gearbox carrier from Alpine's 2024 Formula 1 car has been paired with a race-spec rear wing featuring a working DRS flap for an unusual collector's display
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
A piece of Alpine's 2024 Formula 1 car is about to go up for auction, and it has been turned into something you could actually put in your living room.

F1 Authentics, the official memorabilia platform of F1, is opening bidding on a very cool 2024 race-used gearbox carrier paired with a race-spec rear wing, mounted together on a custom-built display stand. The gearbox carrier still carries its original FIA seal, and the wing keeps a working DRS flap.
It could make for an incredible thing to lean on while you look soulfully out of the window drinking your morning coffee.

The lot, that makes up part of 'The Austin Auction,' is titled the BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team 2024 Race-Used Gearbox Carrier & Rear Wing Assembly. Only the gearbox carrier is described as race-used; the rear wing is a race-specification part.

Made from carbon fibre and metal, the gearbox carrier forms part of the car's rear structure while the wing above it, still in Alpine's pink-and-blue BWT livery with Castrol branding on the endplates, manages airflow and creates downforce at the rear of the car.
The DRS flap can still be opened and closed. And what an incredible showing that would be for when you have visitors.
Esteban Ocon, Alpine, Pierre Gasly, Alpine
While 2024 wasn't the perfect season for Alpine, it did result in a double podium for the then-all-French lineup.
After a difficult start, the team finished sixth in the constructors' standings, helped by a wet race at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, where Esteban Ocon finished second and Pierre Gasly third.

法拉利为刘易斯·汉密尔顿揭幕了一款特别的巴西主题帽子，他将佩戴这款帽子参加2026年的巴西大奖赛
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1车队新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
法拉利揭幕了一款巴西主题帽子，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中佩戴，粉丝们可以在比赛前几天购买自己的帽子。
Maranello车队与Puma在10月16日通过Instagram联合发布了这款帽子。"莱维斯将在Interlagos赛道上戴上带着一小块巴西元素的帽子。而且它很快也将属于你。将于11月3日开始发售，"车队在展示七届冠军戴着新设计的帽子的照片时写道。
这款帽子以大胆的黄色为主题，细节处有磨损效果，露出下面的绿色，反映了巴西国旗的颜色。法拉利标志以银色突出地放置在前面，与银色的Puma标志相匹配，缝制在帽檐右侧。
"给我来一顶吧，莱维斯先生，"一位粉丝评论道，另一位粉丝补充说："我甚至不是法拉利的粉丝，但这真的很酷。我也想戴。"
其他人质疑这款帽子是否是法拉利车手将在Interlagos赛事中引入类似特殊头盔的信号。
汉密尔顿于2022年11月正式成为巴西的荣誉公民。
"我想对在这里的每一个人说声大大的谢谢，对于那些为了让这一天成为可能而搬山填海的人，" 41岁的汉密尔顿当时说。"这对我来说真的是一种巨大的荣誉，能够在这里接受和接受这个公民身份。我真的感觉现在我是你们中的一员，终于。
"当我2007年第一次来到这里[汉密尔顿的第一个F1赛季]，这里的爱是如何增长的，我们共同的经历，尤其是2021年[他向胜利发起冲击]，知道你们一直在我身后为我加油，这是我一生中最特别的时刻之一。我迫不及待地想要继续努力向前。
"我真的很想将今天，这个荣誉，献给埃尔顿·塞纳——献给埃尔顿的家庭，他的朋友和他的粉丝。对我来说，当我五岁的时候，我第一次看到埃尔顿赛车，那就是我知道我想要成为世界冠军，就像他一样。
“那时我才知道并了解了巴西。那时我开始以巴西队的身份玩FIFA！但实际上，通过他的眼睛，我看到了巴西人有多么热情，这种热爱和激情有多深，你对国家的热爱有多么美好。我非常兴奋能在这里多待一些时间。”
2026年巴西大奖赛将于11月6日至8日举行，这将是一个三连赛的一部分，从10月23日至25日的美国大奖赛开始，接着是10月30日至11月1日的墨西哥大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
Ferrari has unveiled a special Brazil-themed cap for Lewis Hamilton to wear at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has revealed a Brazil-themed cap that Lewis Hamilton will wear at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and fans will be able to buy their own a few days before the race.

The Maranello outfit announced the cap in a joint Instagram post with Puma on 16 October. "Lewis will be wearing a small piece of Brazil with him at Interlagos. And it can also be yours soon. Available to buy on November 3rd," the team wrote alongside photos of the seven-time champion wearing the new design.

The cap features a bold yellow theme with distressed detailing that reveals green underneath, reflecting the colours of the Brazilian flag. The Ferrari logo is prominently placed on the front in silver, with a matching silver Puma logo embroidered on the front right of the bill.
"Give me one right now, Sir Lewis Hamilton," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm not even a Ferrari fan, but that is slick. I'd wear it."
Others questioned whether the cap could be a sign that the Ferrari driver will introduce a similar special helmet for the race at Interlagos.
Hamilton officially became an honorary citizen of Brazil in November 2022.

"I’d like to say a big, big thank you to everyone here at the house, for all those who’ve moved mountains to make this day possible," the 41-year-old said at the time. "It is honestly the greatest honour for me to be here receiving and accepting this citizenship. I really do feel like now I’m one of you, finally.

"When I arrived here in 2007 [Hamilton’s first F1 season], the love that’s grown, the experiences we’ve had and, particularly 2021 [his charge to victory], knowing you guys were cheering me on the way, it was one of the most special moments of my entire life. I can’t wait for us to continue to strive ahead.

"I really want to dedicate today, this honour, to Ayrton Senna – to Ayrton’s family, to his friends and to his fans. For me, when I was five years old, I saw Ayrton race for the first time, and that was the moment I knew that I wanted to be a world champion, just like him.

"It was then that I knew and learnt about Brazil. It was then that I started to play FIFA as Brazil! But really, through his eyes, I was able to see how passionate Brazilians were, and how deep it goes, the love and passion you have for your country, and how beautiful it is. I’m so excited to spend some more time here."

The 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is scheduled for 6-8 November and will round out a triple-header starting with the United States Grand Prix from 23-25 October followed by the Mexican Grand Prix from 30 October to 1 November.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
